captions_note: the plaque and the small frame stay above or beside the head, so the reel's captions keep their place
in_a_reel: make the slot ACROSS the cut after the line: about 3 s before it to about 0.4 s after it. The push-in and blur run through that cut
the two lengths are read from the reel project (source clips, segments.json). Build it after the cuts are final. Typed lengths must be the buyer's real ones
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's style (digit_font, label_font, colours) before the first build
steps: edit RAW_LABEL, FINAL_LABEL and T_IN in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the lengths, the places, the times and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
